howItWorksHero: Bao tʋʋm-neda bɩ tʋʋm Afrika ti-lʋɩrẽ, ne bãane sẽn yaa sɩda, Kojo paoongo sẽn yaa kõ-m-meng yĩnga.

howStep2Desc: Kiliyan wã pʋʋsda tʋʋm-neda sẽn sõmda ne yẽ n paood ne Orange Money, Wave bɩ bank carte. Ligd wã bɩ be konto sẽn yaa kõ-m-meng Kojo: kiliyan wã bɩ tʋʋm-neda wã, ned ba a ye ka tõe n sɩɩg a ye n ta tʋʋm wã sẽn wa sɛ.
howStep3Desc: Tʋʋm wã sẽn wa sɛ, kiliyan wã yõogda la ligd wã n kẽngda tʋʋm-neda wã nengẽ yɛ. Yaa nana, vẽeneg, yell ka be ye.

escrowGuarantee1: ✅ Kiliyan wã paooda yembr, sɩngrẽ — paoongo sẽn yaa kõom-dãmb ka be ye.
escrowGuarantee2: ✅ Tʋʋm-neda wã miime b sẽn na n nõ-a sɛ.

faq1q: Yɑɑ bõe tɩ b paood kõ-m-mengẽ?
faq1a: Kõ-m-meng wã gũuda neb a yiib fãa: kiliyan wã miime tɩ b pa yɛɛgd ligd wã hal tɩ tʋʋm wã sɛ, la tʋʋm-neda wã miime tɩ b na n nõ-a. Yaa bãane ning platform wʋsg sẽn ka tar ye.
faq2a: Orange Money (Senegal, Mali, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire), Wave (Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire) la bank carte.
faq3a: Kiliyan wã sẽn wa n yõog tʋʋm wã sẽn sɛ, sõor ning sẽn be kõ-m-mengẽ (n yit Kojo commission, b sẽn yõogda paoongo taoore) n kẽngda tʋʋm-neda wã mobile money konto wã nengẽ tɩ yɛ.
faq4q: Bõe n na n yɩɩd yell sã n be?
faq4a: Paoongo wã bee kõ-m-mengẽ hal tɩ b yõog tʋʋm wã. Yell sã n be, Kojo team wã kẽeda ne support wã. Tʋʋm wã sã n yõg sɩngrẽ, b lebsda ligd wã n kõ kiliyan wã tɩ yɛ.
